properties.description: Permanent left Chat pane; Windows and Pi-supported provider setup, likely DeepSeek. Five full-height picker sections New/Later/Active/Channels/History, explicit attention and buildspace scope. Compact composer, Markdown, multi-range source references, reply/quote/copy/edit, per-message scrolling, measured one-row timing and execution details. Per-instance jump/stop; Pi steering/follow-up. MVP one human/one agent, extensible participant model. Agent can inspect/edit/test and manipulate Broccoli planning through the same owner operations.
